proposed_action: Mass-enroll all platform users into a new data-sharing program with retroactive consent assumed.
raw_reasoning:
Mass-enrolling users into a data-sharing program while assuming retroactive consent would affect users’ personal data and autonomy, and they would not reasonably expect permission to be waived or retroactively granted. This is a substantive change to how their data is used, so consent should be obtained before proceeding rather than presumed.  

Consent required: YES  
Consent type: OPT-IN  
Confidence: HIGH
